note: Design graphics: the chat model writes a JSON brief (title, layout, labels, numbers, style) from a passage, and DocBlocks compiles the image model's prompt from it. Passages come from the ai-diagrams corpus; the marker finds the passage.

cases.title: What customers told us
cases.prompt: A clean infographic of the survey's key numbers.

cases.title: From visitor to customer
cases.prompt: A funnel graphic of the signup steps and how many people reach each.

cases.title: Our story
cases.prompt: A timeline graphic of the company's milestones.

cases.title: How a release ships
cases.prompt: A step-by-step process graphic of the release.

cases.title: How the product fits together
cases.prompt: A simple graphic of the product's three main parts.
